title: Avatar model clip metadata
description: metadata.json: an object keyed by the original clip file name (e.g. 'Wan2.2_i2v_00571_.mp4'). The packaged file in clipDir is '<stem>frag.mp4'.

category.description: Clip category, e.g. 'idle'. Idle clips become root states in generate_fsm.py.

duration.description: Clip duration in MILLISECONDS (batch_video.py quantizes to 16fps, e.g. 5062.5 for 81 frames).
